source_title: Guidelines for representing your business on Google
claim_supported: Supports accurate real-world business names precise addresses minimal representative categories controlled phone numbers and separate treatment of regular special office and gate hours; specifically tells storage facilities to use office hours or otherwise front-gate hours.
limitations: Google-product rules only and mutable; not proof of profile ownership verification ranking facility identity or any modSTORAGE location fact.

claim_supported: Supports storing complete standardized U.S. mailing-address elements and maintaining validated address content rather than a single unstructured display string.
limitations: Mail-address standard only; does not establish legal ownership physical operations profile eligibility map-pin accuracy or customer-facing directions. The official web reader rendered the October 2024 PDF while direct curl returned HTTP 404.

claim_supported: Supports storing a named time-zone identifier because the database periodically changes offsets boundaries and daylight-saving rules and enables software to calculate local time.
limitations: Software time-zone data only; does not establish a facility's hours holiday schedule staffing or time-source correctness.

claim_supported: Provides a current machine-readable vocabulary type for a self-storage facility and exposes inherited place and local-business properties such as address telephone geo branch code and opening hours.
limitations: Development vocabulary rather than a legal registry or search-result promise; markup does not prove ownership accuracy eligibility indexing ranking or rich-result display.

claim_supported: Provides separate fields for street locality region postal code country and related postal-address elements that can mirror a governed facility fact record.
limitations: Development vocabulary only; not postal validation legal-address evidence or permission to publish private address data.

claim_supported: Provides structured fields for day opening and closing times and valid-from or valid-through intervals supporting separation of recurring and date-bounded hours.
limitations: Development vocabulary only; not proof that hours are current customer-facing safe staffed or accepted by any search platform.

claim_supported: Defines general provenance concepts for entities activities agents generation use derivation attribution association and delegation that can link a fact value to its source owner and update event.
limitations: Provenance vocabulary only; does not prove truth authority ownership relationship publication indexing or operational safety.
